system:
You are evaluating draft replies from an automated customer-support agent for Spotify's Twitter support account, as it operated in 2017.

Score the CANDIDATE REPLY on five criteria, each an integer 1-5.

correctness - Is what it says actually true for Spotify, and does it address what the customer asked?
  1 = wrong or answers a different question   3 = partially right, or vague but not wrong
  5 = accurate and on-point

groundedness - Is every claim supported by the PRECEDENTS shown?
  1 = main claims appear nowhere in the precedents   3 = loosely related to them
  5 = every factual claim traceable to a precedent

consistency - Does it handle this the way the precedents show Spotify handled similar cases (same action, same level of caution, same register)?
  1 = contradicts how Spotify handled these   3 = plausible but diverges
  5 = matches the precedents' approach

helpfulness - Does it move the customer forward?
  1 = useless or pure deflection   3 = generic but usable
  5 = a clear next step or a real answer

no_unsupported_claims - Does it avoid inventing policies, prices, timeframes, or promising account actions (refunds, resets, unlocks) the agent cannot perform?
  1 = makes a promise or states a policy with no support   3 = borderline hedged claim
  5 = makes no unsupported claim at all

Judge only the reply in front of you. The REFERENCE REPLY is what Spotify actually sent; it is context, not a target - a different but equally good reply should score well, and copying the reference does not automatically score 5.

Return ONLY JSON:
{"correctness": n, "groundedness": n, "consistency": n, "helpfulness": n, "no_unsupported_claims": n, "rationale": "<one sentence>"}

pls up ur podcast selection. Lots of stuff I can't find on ur platform, but I use u for music. Would like to do the same 4 pods.

[1477031] past customer: you guys should add the Art of podcast to your library!! PLEASE!
     spotify replied: Hey there! We're working hard with rights holders to get more of the best content on the service. Stay tuned

[153784] past customer: any chance you can make a standalone podcast app? Or have features like stop playing after X minutes or when the podcast ends?
     spotify replied: Hey Kal, we can see how that'd be useful! You can vote for the official idea here: <link> Stay awesome 😁

[830575] past customer: your podcasts play backwards. EG when ep4 is over will skip to ep3. Very frustrating. #podcasts #Spotify <link>
     spotify replied: 1: Hi Colin! Don't worry, help's here. Just to check, could you try filtering the episodes by date? Just tap the three lines....

[1186038] past customer: How do I go about adding my podcast to Spotify?
     spotify replied: Hey Glenn! Thanks for your interest! For more info on getting your podcast on Spotify, check out: <link>

[2302497] past customer: Hey I'm waiting for the new We Need To Talk About podcast to come out. 🙃
     spotify replied: Hey there! We'll have it available to you as soon as it's available to us! <link>

CANDIDATE REPLY (score this):
Hey there! We're working hard with rights holders to get more of the best content on the service. Stay tuned

REFERENCE REPLY actually sent by Spotify (context only):
Hey there! Thanks for the feedback. We'd love to have more podcasts available, but we have some info about content here: <link>

Return the JSON scores.
text: {"correctness":5,"groundedness":5,"consistency":5,"helpfulness":3,"no_unsupported_claims":5,"rationale":"The reply directly acknowledges the request and matches Spotify’s precedent for unavailable podcast content, though it offers only a generic update and no actionable next step."}
